intro: Oil made the UAE rich, but Dubai shows how it has diversified into trade, tourism, aviation and finance.

chapters.title: Oil and beyond
text: Abu Dhabi holds most of the oil, and its sovereign wealth funds are among the largest in the world. Dubai has little oil and grew through its port at Jebel Ali, its airline Emirates and tourism.
Dubai International is one of the busiest airports in the world for international passengers.

chapters.title: Future
text: The UAE is investing in solar power, nuclear power at Barakah and artificial intelligence.
